items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That Ralph Burns date I think I was with Atlantic at that time. [He] said that . . . I’m not supposed to play any solos. Norman said “That’s okay”. He wanted me to play some solos on that record and I did.

ctx.x: He treated you well even if he wasn’t a big fan of your music.

Right. That Ralph Burns date I think I was with Atlantic at that time. [He] said that . . . I’m not supposed to play any solos. Norman said “That’s okay”. He wanted me to play some solos on that record and I did. Same thing I did with Mingus. He wrote out a solo for me.
